responsibility: Implements the GNU Modula-2 gm2-ici emission layer for user-visible diagnostics and special source locations. It formats errors, warnings, and notes from lexer/token positions obtained through M2LexBuf into file:line:column output, applies colorized presentation, handles the alternate Xcode-style position suffix, flushes output to the tool front end, and provides the module’s generic internal-error abort path. It also exports the canonical unknown and builtins locations by forwarding the corresponding token/location constants used by the surrounding gm2 tools and cc1gm2 integration.
